title: SpellDef
description:
A spell definition from JSON type `"SPELL"`.

Defines a magical spell or special ability with various effects, targeting rules, scaling parameters, and resource costs.

additional_linked_spells.description: Additional linked spells that are also cast.

aoe_increment.description: Area of effect increment per level (numeric or math expression).

base_casting_time.description: Base casting time in moves (numeric or math expression).

base_energy_cost.description: Base energy cost (numeric or math expression).

casting_time_increment.description: Casting time change per level (can be negative, numeric or math expression).

components.description: Components required to cast the spell (references a component definition).

damage_increment.description: Damage increment per level (numeric or math expression).

duration_increment.description: Duration increment per level (numeric or math expression).

effect_str.description: Effect target string (e.g. item ID, monster group ID, effect ID).

energy_increment.description: Energy cost change per level (can be negative, numeric or math expression).

extra_effects.description: Additional spells linked to this one (extra effects).

field_chance.description: Chance of field spawning each tick (numeric or math expression).

field_intensity_increment.description: Field intensity increment per level (numeric or math expression).

final_casting_time.description: Final casting time at max_level (numeric or math expression).

final_energy_cost.description: Final energy cost at max_level (numeric or math expression).

flags.description: Spell flags (e.g. "SILENT", "CONCENTRATE", "VERBAL", "SOMATIC", "PERMANENT", "NO_EXPLOSION_SFX"). Can be a sequence or a map/object.

learn_spells.description: List of spells learned when this spell reaches certain levels. Can be a sequence or a map of spell_id: level.

max_aoe.description: Maximum area of effect radius at max_level (numeric or math expression).

max_damage.description: Maximum damage at max_level (numeric or math expression).

max_duration.description: Maximum duration at max_level (numeric or math expression).

max_field_intensity.description: Maximum field intensity (numeric or math expression).

max_level.description: Maximum level attainable for this spell (numeric or math expression).

max_range.description: Maximum range at max_level (numeric or math expression).

message.description: Message displayed when the spell is cast.

min_aoe.description: Minimum area of effect radius at level 0 (numeric or math expression).

min_damage.description: Minimum damage at level 0 (numeric or math expression).

min_duration.description: Minimum duration (in movement points/moves) at level 0 (numeric or math expression).

min_field_intensity.description: Minimum field intensity (numeric or math expression).

min_range.description: Minimum range at level 0 (numeric or math expression).

range_increment.description: Range increment per level (numeric or math expression).

shape.description: Shape of the spell's area of effect (e.g. "blast", "cone", "line").

valid_targets.description: Valid target types for the spell (e.g. ["ground", "self", "hostile", "ally"]). Can be a sequence or a map/object.

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
